args.text: ;LANGID=0x0409;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0
CREATE TABLE DG (d LONG CONSTRAINT PK_DG PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (0)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (1)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (2)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (3)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (4)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (5)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (6)
INSERT INTO DG VALUES (7)
CREATE TABLE NUM (n LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NUM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO NUM (n) SELECT a.d * 64 + b.d * 8 + c.d + 1 FROM DG AS a, DG AS b, DG AS c ORDER BY a.d, b.d, c.d
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM NUM
CREATE TABLE SM (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_SM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO SM (id) SELECT n FROM NUM WHERE n < 50 ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE ER (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_ER PRIMARY KEY, pad TEXT(120), zf LONG, zm LONG, zl LONG, zp LONG, zq LONG, tx TEXT(10), tq TEXT(10), ov LONG)

INSERT INTO ER (id, pad, zf, zm, zl, zp, zq, tx, tq, ov) SELECT n, Space(100), IIf(n = 3, 0, 1), IIf(n = 100, 0, 1), IIf(n = 240, 0, 1), IIf(n = 50 Or n = 150, 0, 1), IIf(n = 80, 0, 1), IIf(n = 60, 'x', '1'), IIf(n = 80, 'x', '1'), IIf(n = 150, 100000, 1) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 240 ORDER BY n
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Min(id) AS lo, Max(id) AS hi FROM ER
SELECT id, zf, zm, zl, zp, zq, tx, tq, ov FROM ER WHERE zf = 0 OR zm = 0 OR zl = 0 OR zp = 0 OR zq = 0 OR tx = 'x' OR tq = 'x' OR ov <> 1
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM SM
